description: Defines types, enums, and classes for representing GLSL shader variables, interface blocks, and related concepts within the ANGLE project, including shader variable metadata, interface block structures, and work group size specifications.

classes.name: ShaderVariable
classes.description: Represents a shader variable (uniform, varying, attribute, etc.) with metadata such as type, name, array sizes, and layout qualifiers.

classes.name: InterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents an interface block in GLSL shaders, including its name, layout, fields, and array size.

classes.name: WorkGroupSize
classes.description: Encapsulates the size of a compute shader work group, with methods to set, compare, and validate sizes.

methods.name: ShaderVariable(GLenum typeIn)
methods.description: Constructor initializing ShaderVariable with a specific type.

methods.name: ShaderVariable(GLenum typeIn, unsigned int arraySizeIn)
methods.description: Constructor initializing ShaderVariable with a specific type and array size.

methods.name: findInfoByMappedName
methods.description: Finds variable info by its mapped name, returning the leaf variable and original name.

methods.name: isSameUniformAtLinkTime
methods.description: Determines if two uniform variables are equivalent at link time.

methods.name: isSameInterfaceBlockFieldAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if two interface block fields are the same at link time.

methods.name: isSameVaryingAtLinkTime
methods.description: Checks if two varyings are the same at link time, considering shader version.

methods.name: WorkGroupSize(int initialSize)
methods.description: Constructor initializing all size qualifiers to a specific value.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets all work group size qualifiers to a specific value.

methods.name: isWorkGroupSizeMatching
methods.description: Checks if two work group sizes match.

methods.name: isAnyValueSet
methods.description: Checks if any size value is set.

methods.name: isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if all size values are set.

methods.name: isLocalSizeValid
methods.description: Checks if the local size qualifiers are valid.
